news.headline: Abivax SA Sponsored ADR (NASDAQ:ABVX) Given Average Recommendation of "Moderate Buy" by Brokerages
news.summary: Of fifteen brokerages covering Abivax, thirteen rate it Buy, one Hold and one Sell, with an average 12-month price target around $156.50. The consensus reflects continued optimism heading into the planned Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing for obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax said the FDA gave constructive feedback aligning on the content, format and strategy of the planned New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track to submit the NDA in late Q4 2026.

news.headline: Abivax (NASDAQ:ABVX) Price Target Raised to $180.00 at Morgan Stanley
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reissued an Overweight rating on Abivax and lifted its price target to $180 from $132, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod regulatory and commercial path following the Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data and FDA alignment.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders (marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a former Amgen/Takeda ENTYVIO executive) as it builds out its U.S. organization ahead of a planned obefazimod NDA filing and potential solo U.S. launch.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized, oversubscribed ADS offering (7.36 million ADSs at $125) for gross proceeds of $920 million after underwriters fully exercised their option, extending the company's cash runway into 2029 and funding a potential independent U.S. launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax's $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the newly raised capital gives Abivax the option to commercialize obefazimod independently in the U.S. rather than being forced into a takeover or licensing deal, even as speculation about a big pharma acquisition continues.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA in July 2026 that aligned on content, format and strategy, Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active UC in late Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA marketing authorisation application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit a MAA to the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in UC in the second half of 2026, alongside the FDA NDA, subject to continued supportive Phase 3 maintenance data.

catalysts.label: H1/Q3 2026 financial results and corporate update
catalysts.detail: Abivax's next scheduled financial disclosure will provide an updated cash position (runway guided into 2029 after the $920M raise) and progress update on regulatory filings.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: 12-week induction-phase topline results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected around mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA Priority Review / launch preparation
catalysts.detail: If the NDA is accepted, Abivax is building out U.S. commercial infrastructure (four new commercial leadership hires announced July 2026) to support a potential independent U.S. launch of obefazimod rather than an out-license.

catalysts.label: Takeover / partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Despite the large equity raise reducing near-term financing pressure, market speculation about a large pharma acquisition or partnership for obefazimod persists; CEO has said the company is now positioned to launch solo if no deal materializes.

pulse: ABVX has consolidated in the $120-$130 range through August 2026 after its blockbuster run on positive Phase 3 ABTECT ulcerative colitis data earlier in the year, with the company now flush with cash following a $920 million ADS offering that closed in early July and extends runway into 2029. Newsflow since mid-July has been steadily positive and de-risking: a constructive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA, new commercial leadership hires ahead of a planned late-Q4 2026 NDA filing, and continued analyst upgrades (Morgan Stanley to $180, consensus Moderate Buy near $156). The next major catalysts are the FDA NDA and EMA MAA submissions expected in the second half of 2026, while the Crohn's disease opportunity (ENHANCE-CD) remains a longer-dated call option with data not due until mid-2027.
